about.label: About Me
about.p1: I'm a 21-year-old R&D Engineer at MST, based in Moscow and relocating to Tbilisi. I specialize in building browser automation systems, Chrome extensions, and full-stack applications.
about.p2: My path to engineering has been anything but linear. Starting with a game development internship at Sinaptik, then diving into Digital Marketing Operations — managing 100+ Google Ads accounts across 20+ countries — taught me to think at scale and automate everything. That experience naturally evolved into building the tools themselves.
about.p3: Today I work with Node.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL on the frontend and backend, while integrating AI models like Claude and Mistral into production workflows. I'm passionate about solving complex problems with clean, maintainable code.

roles.title: R&D Engineer
roles.description: Transferred from the marketing department to R&D. Building browser automation systems, Chrome extensions for CTS Anti-Fraud analytics, and full-stack monitoring dashboards. Working with Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, and AI integrations (Claude API, Mistral).
